summary.text: Becky Jo Alexander, listed by the legislature and Ballotpedia as Representative Rebecca Alexander, is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 7, part of Washington County, who lives in Jonesborough and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is a motivational speaker and storyteller.

paragraphs.text: Alexander graduated from Daniel Boone High School in 1976, earned a B.A. in English and sociology/psychology with a teaching certificate in English from Milligan College, and holds an M.Ed. from East Tennessee State University with an emphasis in storytelling.
The legislature's biography lists her as a motivational speaker and storyteller, and she is a performing member of the Jonesborough Storytelling Guild.
Alexander is a member of the House for the 112th and 114th General Assemblies and serves as Majority Caucus Treasurer in the 114th.
She is a member of the Agriculture & Natural Resources, Judiciary and Transportation committees.
